messages:
olivia-cs: FYI forwarded from Acme: console shows $200 trial credits under Billing > Credits, but their API calls return 402 and the usage/balance endpoints show 0. Customer blocked in prod, says they started integration yesterday. Can someone look?

alex-eng: can you paste the account_id/org_id and a curl repro (sanitized api key ok)?

olivia-cs: account_id: acct_0A1B2C3D org_id: org-acme-77 customer says they call with their org key like this:

```
curl -i https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-org-acme-XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4-mini","input":"hi"}'
```

Response: HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
{"error":"insufficient_funds","balance":0,"currency":"USD"}

Also console screenshot: Billing > Credits shows "$200 promotional credit" (applied: yes, expires in 29 days).

alex-eng: hm. Two quick possibilities: 1) credits granted to a different billing account than the project's billing_account, or 2) credits are display-only (console cache) and not actually applied to billing_account. Can you confirm the billing_account id for org-acme-77 (from customer) and the credit_grant id if available?

olivia-cs: customer sent this: project billing_account: ba-5678, screenshot of credits panel lists grant id: grant-90X (but I can't see the grant's BA)

sanjay-billing: pulling internal now. Running a lookup: SELECT grant_id, billing_account_id, amount_cents, status FROM credit_grants WHERE grant_id='grant-90X'; 

Found: grant-90X -> billing_account_id = ba-1234, amount_cents = 20000, status = ACTIVE.

sanjay-billing: and for org-acme-77 project mapping: org_acme_77 -> billing_account_id = ba-5678. So the grant is active but attached to a different billing account (ba-1234). That explains why console (which surfaces all grants visible to support) shows the promo, but the customer's project is billed under ba-5678.

alex-eng: that mismatch would cause API token for org-acme-77 to see balance 0 and 402. Good catch. Is ba-1234 an old test billing account?

sanjay-billing: ba-1234 is a promo pool used by marketing in Q4 last year. Looks like the grant got created against the wrong BA due to a form dropdown bug. I'll reassign the grant to ba-5678. Doing admin action: 

```
# admin action (audit logged)
UPDATE credit_grants SET billing_account_id='ba-5678', audit_note='reassign grant to customer billing account - support ticket 5482' WHERE grant_id='grant-90X' AND billing_account_id='ba-1234';
```
This will not change amounts or expiry. Will invalidate cached console views for ~30s.

billing-bot: credit-grant-reassign job started (job_id: job-7712). audit: user=sanjay-billing action=grant_reassign grant=grant-90X from=ba-1234 to=ba-5678

sanjay-billing: job completed: job-7712 status=SUCCESS. cache invalidation triggered for org_acme_77.

olivia-cs: I just asked the customer to retry; they reported immediately: API now returns 200 and the generation worked, usage shows tokens deducted and credits decreasing. They said :tada:.

emily-cs: Next steps: 1) notify marketing that their promo pool ba-1234 was used incorrectly, 2) add a guard in the grant form to only show BA's matching customer domain to avoid similar, 3) follow up with customer confirming resolution and offer apology credit for disruption.

sanjay-billing: agree. I opened internal ticket BILL-892 to add validation and to scan recent grants for BA mismatches.

olivia-cs: customer is happy, closing ticket. Thanks all :smile:
